title: Majestically Optimized
description: The best Minecraft modpack to enhance your gaming experience, reducing lag and adding a bunch of helpful tweaks to the game, as listed in the description.
body:
# READ BEFORE PLAYING:

**Majestically Optimized** is a modpack focusing primarily on reducing FPS, while also providing essential quality of life mods! This modpack adds features such as:
- Having a **saturation bar**
- Being able to **zoom your camera** by pressing c
- **Looking around while running** by pressing left alt
- **Recording** your amazing adventures
- A **minimap** on the corner of your screem
- Many **helpful mouse tweaks**
- **Shader support** to make your game look beautiful
- **Fullbright** anywhere you go

Did you know that our modpack can also make your FPS **2-4 times higher**? We highly recommend you download this modpack for the best gaming experience!

**🤝 Credits:**

Majestically Optimized is an unofficial fork of the incredible Fabulously Optimized modpack. This project is not officially endorsed by, associated with, or supported by the original Fabulously Optimized team. Huge thanks to the original creators and contributors for building the foundation of this performance experience!

**📦 Additional Mods Included:**

To build upon the base optimization, this fork integrates the following main individual modifications:

- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) – Enhances inventory management mechanics with convenient mouse drag controls.
- [Replay Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/replaymod) – Advanced gameplay recording, cinematic camera tracks, and rendering utilities.
- [Freelook](https://modrinth.com/mod/freelook) – Implements 360-degree third-person perspective viewing while moving.
- [Gamma Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) – Grants fullbright functionality with custom brightness sliders and toggles.
- [JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap) – Integrates a real-time world map and minimap system for effortless navigation.
